_readme: Durable log of per-page GSC query-alignment data pulled from page-audit tools (e.g. getveritas.io Page Audit). See seo-audits/keyword-overlap-playbook.md for the recording format, how scripts/check-keyword-overlap.ts consumes this file, and what to do when it flags a genuine overlap. Do not hand-edit position/impressions after the fact — append a new audit entry instead so history is preserved.
